timely.label: On This Day
timely.line: Four years ago today, Taylor Swift released her album Midnights.

timely.label: Today Is
timely.line: Thursday is National Make a Dog's Day, a day for giving your dog extra love and thinking about the shelter dogs still waiting for a home.

timely.label: Movie Night
timely.line: The new stop-motion movie Wildwood opens in theaters Friday, about a girl who goes into a secret enchanted forest to save her baby brother, adapted from the children's novel.

timely.label: On TV
timely.line: Reba McEntire's NBC sitcom Happy's Place returns for its third season Friday.

timely.label: On This Day
timely.line: Saturday marks 20 years since Taylor Swift released her debut album, which made her a rising star in country music.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: The Consumer Product Safety Commission says Papablic is recalling its convertible bedside sleepers with play yard extensions, because the mattress can shift and trap a baby between the sleeping pad and the bottom, a risk of serious injury or death.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: The Consumer Product Safety Commission says ONTHEWEI is recalling its baby bath seats because they are unstable and can tip over while in use, a risk of serious injury or death to children.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit mom is asking whether a babysitter who earned $120 for four hours of date-night babysitting, plus $20 for gas, should have tidied the kids' messes before she left.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit dad says he can't believe he used to get frustrated and yell at his 2-year-old, now that his oldest is almost 5 and still seems like a baby to him.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit parent with a 2-year-old is asking whether visiting grandparents are guests or help with the kids.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Budget Bytes has an easy Southern smothered pork chops recipe, with seared pork chops in creamy onion gravy, ready in 35 minutes.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Budget Bytes' Rasta Pasta is a one-pot meal of jerk-seasoned chicken, colorful peppers and a creamy Parmesan sauce, ready in 45 minutes.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Skinnytaste's cheesy turkey and black bean enchiladas, made with seasoned ground turkey and homemade enchilada sauce, pack 15 grams of fiber per serving.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: The Missouri Department of Conservation is asking Ozarks hunters to have their deer sampled for chronic wasting disease all season, at MDC offices, meat processors, taxidermists, freezer drops and more.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: The Missouri Department of Conservation says waterfowl hunters should be poised for fall flights similar to 2025, and reminds them of changes to zone boundaries and season dates.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: A fisheries biologist caught the same monster muskie he released last year, and autumn is prime time for big muskies because they feed heavily before winter.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: NerdWallet says if your bills are due before payday, asking to move your bill due dates can ease your cash flow.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Lifehacker says Spotify Family plan members are being prompted to confirm their location by scanning a QR code, and need to do it to avoid being locked out.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A thread on r/Frugal asks which products are at an all-time low price right now, since things like computer memory and graphics cards are at all-time highs.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A r/Frugal poster says a $280 gas bill last January had them wearing a hat and gloves indoors, and wishes they had bought a heated vest three winters ago.
